system:
You extract health-related facts from a chat between a USER and a COACH.
Rules: use ONLY what the USER explicitly states about themselves. If a feature is not stated, value=null. NEVER guess or infer. Convert units to the unit shown. For vague amounts ('a few'), give a best numeric estimate with confidence <= 0.5. Binary features: 1=yes, 0=no. Put the user's own words in 'evidence'.
Features:
- AddSugars (tsp-eq/day): Added sugar intake per day (approximate from sugary drinks and sweets)
- BMXHT (cm): Body height (self-reported)
- BMXWAIST (cm): Waist circumference (self-measured)
- BMXWT (kg): Body weight (self-reported)
- PAminWk (minutes/week): Physical activity minutes per week
- ScreenTime (hours/day): Screen time per day (TV, computer, phone)
- MealsOut (meals/week): Number of meals per week not prepared at home
- HOD050 (count): Number of rooms in the home
- RIDAGEYR (years): Age in years
- FamIncC (category): Family income category
- HIns4 (0/1): Has health insurance
- MilkType (category): Type of milk usually drunk
- NwkMeals (per week): Number of school meals per week
- TimesHCLastYr (count): Number of health care visits in the past year
- HHSizCat (category): Household size category
- NwkBkfast (per week): School breakfasts eaten per week
- Milk30Days (category): How often the person drank milk in the past 30 days
- DMDHRGND (category): Sex of the household reference person
- AgeAsthma (years): Age when asthma was first diagnosed
- FamPIRCat (category): Family income to poverty ratio category
- HealthCond (count): Number of reported health conditions
- FdInCH (category): Child food security status
- HHRAge (category): Age group of the household reference person
- HUQ020_1 (0/1): General health compared to last year: category 1
- RaceEth_2 (0/1): Race/ethnicity category 2 (indicator)
- RIAGENDR (0/1): Sex of the person (as coded in the dataset)
- NwkLunch (per week): School lunches eaten per week
- HHSmkNum (count): Number of smokers in the household
- FdStmp (0/1): Household receives food stamps (SNAP)
- BMIcat (category): BMI category (computed from weight, height, age, sex)

Return ONLY JSON: {"<feature>": {"value": number|null, "confidence": 0-1, "evidence": string|null}, ...}

messages.content:
USER: Hey, just wanted to give you a quick update on my eating habits this week.
COACH: Sure thing! How’s it going?
USER: I’m actually not cooking much at home—like, almost none of my meals are made there. I’m basically eating out or grabbing something on the go.
COACH: Got it. Anything else you’ve noticed?
USER: I also skip school breakfast a lot, maybe just once or twice a week. And I usually grab lunch at school, so that’s about one lunch a day.
COACH: Sounds like a busy schedule. What’s the family situation like?
USER: I live with my mom, and she’s the main person in the house. There’s no one else in the household. We don’t have any smokers around.
COACH: Nice, no smoking in the home. How’s your overall health compared to last year?
USER: I feel pretty steady—no big changes, just the usual ups and downs. Also, we’re all pretty good on food security, so that’s a plus.
COACH: Great to hear that. Anything else you want to share?
USER: I’m not sure, that’s about it. Just wanted to keep you in the loop.
